bio.text: Kristina Knickerbocker, a Democrat, is a candidate for Ohio's 10th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election, having advanced from the May 5 Democratic primary.
According to Ballotpedia's profile, which draws on candidate-provided information, she served in the U.S. Air Force from 2015 to 2025 and has worked as a family nurse practitioner.
The profile lists a bachelor's degree from Azusa Pacific University (2014) and a graduate degree from Ohio State University (2022).
